div.div: 4 أَدْرَأَتْ بِضَرْعِهَا , (AZ, T, S,) inf. n. إِدْرَآءٌ, (AZ, T,) [as also اذرأت, with ذ,] She (a camel) excerned (أَنْزَلَتْ) the milk, (AZ, T, S,) and relaxed her udder, on the occasion of bringing forth. (AZ, S.) The epithet applied to the she-camel so doing is ↓ مُدْرِئٌ . (AZ, T, S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
